name: manual_6734bd
claim: Before pushing a local fix-up to a shared PR branch, fetch and check fast-forward; if another actor moved the branch, rebase and resolve each hunk by keeping the stricter remote rule and only the still-new part of the local change, then re-test; never force-push

decisions.notes: 2026-10-25: orama #444 and #445 both gained another actor's commits between review and push; rebasing kept remote Topo-MaskSecrets and the loopback WIN_PEER_ENDPOINT rule and carried forward only the stale-WIN_IP replacement
